Roots Remember Feet

You press your hand toward the ground beneath your enemy. Roots rise from the soil and cracks, winding around their feet and dragging at their steps.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One visible creature standing on ground within 4 squares.

Roots spring from cracks or soil to catch its feet. They wither immediately after the effect; you are not maintaining a grapple.

- Weak: Slowed 1. - Standard: Slowed 2 and pull 1 square toward you. - Strong: Slowed 2, pull 1 square toward you and knock prone.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Wilderness 1

Type: Magic

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: roots-remember-feet
